create_NearestNeighbors: create a NearestNeighbors instance to perform unsupervised nearest neighbor searches on a dataset
fit_NearestNeighbors: fit the NearestNeighbors estimator on a training dataset to build a nearest neighbor index
kneighbors_NearestNeighbors: query the NearestNeighbors model to find the k nearest neighbors for given sample points
radius_neighbors_NearestNeighbors: query the NearestNeighbors model to find all neighbors within a specified radius of each sample
build_NearestNeighbors_brute: build a NearestNeighbors model using brute-force algorithm for exact nearest neighbor search
